title: NIMHANS Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: The National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences, Bangalore (NIMHANS) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill the various vacancies for Junior Research Fellow Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in a post-graduation can grab this chance and apply for the NIMHANS Notification 2026 . Here we provide more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. If you are looking for more,...
